title.en: Volume 283 Biographies 70: Jue Luo Wu Mo Ne, Shu Lan, Tu Li Chen, He Guozong
title.raw: 卷283 列傳七十 觉罗武默讷 舒兰 图理琛 何国宗

sentences.zh: 列傳七十

translations.literal: Biographies 70
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 70

sentences.zh: 覺羅武默訥舒蘭拉錫拉錫子旺札爾孫博靈阿圖理琛何國宗

translations.literal: Jueluo Wu Mo'ne, Shulan, Laxi, Wangzhar, Sun Boling'a, Tulichen, He Guozong
translations.idiomatic: Jueluo Wu Mo'ne, Shulan, Laxi, Wangzhar, Sun Boling'a, Tulichen, and He Guozong

sentences.zh: 覺羅武默訥，正黃旗人，景祖第三兄索長阿四世孫也。

translations.literal: Jueluo Wu Mo'ne was a man of the Plain Yellow Banner, a fourth-generation descendant of Suochang'a, the third elder brother of Emperor Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mo'ne of the Aisin Gioro clan belonged to the Plain Yellow Banner and was a fourth-generation descendant of Suochang'a, the third elder brother of the Jing ancestor.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，授世職拖沙喇哈番，累進三等阿達哈哈番，擢一等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi he was granted the hereditary rank of dorosahafan, was promoted in stages to third-class adahahafan, and was raised to first-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 he received the hereditary dorosahafan rank, rose step by step to third-class adahahafan, and was promoted to first-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年，授內大臣，管佐領。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi he was appointed Grand Minister of the Interior and placed in charge of a company.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 he was made a grand minister of the interior and given command of a banner company.

sentences.zh: 十六年，命偕侍衛費耀色、塞護禮、索鼐瞻禮長白山，諭曰：「長白山祖宗發祥之地，爾等赴吉林，選識路之人，瞻視行禮，並巡視寧古塔諸處，於大暑前馳驛速往。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was ordered, together with bodyguards Fei Yaose, Sai Huli, and Suonai, to pay homage at Mount Changbai. An edict said: "Mount Changbai is the place where our forefathers arose. You are to go to Jilin, choose men who know the route, behold the mountain and perform the rites, and also inspect the region of Ningguta and elsewhere; ride post-haste and arrive before the Great Heat."
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 16 he was sent with bodyguards Fei Yaose, Sai Huli, and Suonai to worship at Mount Changbai. The emperor instructed them: "Mount Changbai is where our dynasty began. Go to Jilin, find guides who know the way, perform the rites of veneration, and inspect Ningguta and the surrounding districts. Travel by courier post and reach your destination before the height of summer."

sentences.zh: 」五月己卯，武默訥等發京師；

translations.literal: " On the jimao day of the fifth month Wu Mo'ne and the others set out from the capital;
translations.idiomatic: " On the jimao day of the fifth month Wu Mo'ne's party left the capital;

sentences.zh: 己丑，至盛京，東行；

translations.literal: on the jichou day they reached Shengjing and traveled east;
translations.idiomatic: on jichou they reached Mukden and pressed eastward;

sentences.zh: 戊戌，至吉林。

translations.literal: on the wuxu day they reached Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: on wuxu they arrived at Jilin.

sentences.zh: 詢土人，無知長白山路者。

translations.literal: They questioned local people, but none knew the route to Mount Changbai.
translations.idiomatic: They asked the locals, yet no one knew the way to Mount Changbai.

sentences.zh: 得舊居額赫訥殷獵戶岱穆布魯，言其父曾獵長白山麓，負鹿歸，道經三宿，似去額赫訥殷不遠。

translations.literal: They found a hunter named Daimuburu who had formerly lived at Ehenen'e Yin, who said his father had once hunted at the foot of Mount Changbai, carried a deer back on the return journey, and spent three nights on the road, which seemed not far from Ehenen'e Yin.
translations.idiomatic: They found a hunter named Daimuburu who had once lived at Ehenen'e Yin. He said his father had hunted at the foot of Mount Changbai and, carrying a deer home, had taken three days on the trail—apparently not far from Ehenen'e Yin.

sentences.zh: 自吉林至額赫訥殷，陸行十日，舟行幾倍之。

translations.literal: From Jilin to Ehenen'e Yin overland took ten days; by boat it took nearly twice as long.
translations.idiomatic: Overland from Jilin to Ehenen'e Yin was ten days' march; by river the journey took nearly twice as long.

sentences.zh: 寧古塔將軍巴海令運米十七艘詣額赫訥殷，先發，並令協領薩布素護武默訥等行。

translations.literal: General Bahai of Ningguta ordered seventeen grain boats sent to Ehenen'e Yin to go ahead, and also ordered Assistant Commandant Sabusu to escort Wu Mo'ne and the others on their journey.
translations.idiomatic: Ningguta general Bahai dispatched seventeen grain boats to Ehenen'e Yin in advance and ordered Assistant Commandant Sabusu to escort Wu Mo'ne's party.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，武默訥等攜三月糧，陸行經溫德亨河、庫埒訥嶺、奇爾薩河、布爾堪河、納丹弗埒城、輝發江、法河、卓隆鄂河，抵訥殷江乾，米亦至。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day of the sixth month Wu Mo'ne and the others took three months' provisions and traveled overland by way of the Wendehun River, Kulun'e Ridge, Qi'ersa River, Bu'erkan River, Nadafulei walled town, Huifa River, Fa River, and Zhuolong'e River, reaching the dry bed of the Nen River, where the grain also arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the sixth month the party set out with three months' rations, marching overland past the Wendehun, Kulun'e Ridge, Qi'ersa, Bu'erkan, Nadafulei, the Huifa, Fa, and Zhuolong'e rivers, until they reached the Nen dry channel, where the grain convoy caught up.

sentences.zh: 乃乘小舟，與薩布素分道行，溯訥殷江逆流上。

translations.literal: They then boarded small boats, separated from Sabusu, and went upstream against the Nen River current.
translations.idiomatic: They then took small boats, parted from Sabusu, and poled upstream on the Nen.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，會於額赫訥殷。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day they met at Ehenen'e Yin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin they rendezvoused at Ehenen'e Yin.

sentences.zh: 一望深林無路，薩布素率眾前行，伐木開道。

translations.literal: Before them stretched deep forest with no path; Sabusu led the men forward and cut trees to open a way.
translations.idiomatic: Ahead lay trackless forest. Sabusu went in front with the men, felling trees to cut a path.

sentences.zh: 遣人還告：行三十里，得一山，升其巔，緣木而望，長白山乃在百餘里外，片片白光如積玉，視之甚晰。

translations.literal: He sent men back to report: after thirty li they reached a hill, climbed its summit, and looking along the treetops saw Mount Changbai more than a hundred li away, patches of white light like piled jade, very clear to the eye.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts returned with word that after thirty li they had climbed a hilltop and, peering over the treetops, could see Mount Changbai more than a hundred li distant—patches of white like heaped jade, startlingly clear.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，武默訥前行。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day Wu Mo'ne advanced.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wu Mo'ne pressed forward.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遇薩布素於林中。

translations.literal: On the jisi day he met Sabusu in the forest.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he rejoined Sabusu in the woods.

sentences.zh: 壬申黎明，大霧，莫辨山所向。

translations.literal: At dawn on the renshen day there was heavy fog and they could not tell which way the mountain lay.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on renshen a thick fog hid the mountain entirely.

sentences.zh: 聞鶴唳，尋聲往，遇鹿蹊，循行至山麓，見周遭密林，中間平迤圓繞，有草無木。

translations.literal: Hearing cranes call, they followed the sound, came upon a deer trail, and followed it to the foot of the mountain, where they saw dense forest all around with a level, gently rounded open space in the middle, grass but no trees.
translations.idiomatic: They followed the cry of cranes, found a deer track, and traced it to the mountain's foot. Dense woods ringed a broad, level meadow bare of trees.

sentences.zh: 前臨小林，盡處有白樺木，整若栽植，及旋行林外，仍瀰漫無所見。

translations.literal: Before them lay a small grove; at its end stood white birches, neat as if planted; but when they circled outside the woods, mist still shrouded everything and nothing could be seen.
translations.idiomatic: Ahead stood a small wood ending in white birches aligned as if planted by hand; yet when they circled outside the trees, fog still closed in and the peak vanished again.

sentences.zh: 跪誦敕旨，拜畢，霧開，峰巒歷歷在目，登陟有路。

translations.literal: They knelt, recited the imperial edict, and when the bowing was finished the fog lifted; the peaks stood clear before them and a path led upward.
translations.idiomatic: They knelt, read aloud the imperial command, and bowed. When the rite ended the mist parted; every peak stood plain to view and a path opened for the ascent.

sentences.zh: 遙望之，山修而扈，既近，則堂平而宇圜，向所睹積玉光，冰雪所凝也。

translations.literal: Seen from afar the mountain was tall and escorted by lesser heights; up close its hall was level and its dome round. The piled-jade light they had seen before was ice and snow congealed.
translations.idiomatic: From a distance the mountain rose tall with attendant peaks; close at hand its summit was broad and round. The jade-like gleam they had glimpsed from afar was compacted ice and snow.

sentences.zh: 山峻約百餘裡，巔有池，環以五峰，其四峰臨水拱峙，正南一峰稍低，分列雙闕。

translations.literal: The mountain's height was about a hundred-odd li; on its summit was a lake ringed by five peaks. Four peaks faced the water and arched around it; the one due south was slightly lower, forming a pair of gate towers.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain rose some hundred li. At the summit lay a lake encircled by five peaks: four leaned over the water in a bow, while the southern peak, slightly lower, stood like twin gate towers.

sentences.zh: 池廣袤約三四十里，夾山澗水噴注，自左流者為松花江，右流者為大小訥殷河，繞山皆平林。

translations.literal: The lake was about thirty or forty li across; mountain streams gushed in on either side. The stream to the left was the Songhua River; to the right were the Greater and Lesser Nen Rivers. Around the mountain were level woods.
translations.idiomatic: The lake stretched thirty or forty li. Streams burst from the flanks: on the left the Songhua, on the right the Greater and Lesser Nen. Level forest ringed the slopes.

sentences.zh: 武默訥瞻拜而下。

translations.literal: Wu Mo'ne paid homage and descended.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mo'ne worshipped and came down.

sentences.zh: 峰巔群鹿奔逸，僕其七，墜武默訥等前。

translations.literal: On the summit a herd of deer fled in panic; seven fell, dropping before Wu Mo'ne and the others.
translations.idiomatic: A herd of deer stampeded on the summit; seven fell dead at Wu Mo'ne's feet.

sentences.zh: 時登山者正七人，方乏食，謝山靈賜。

translations.literal: At that time exactly seven men had climbed the mountain and were short of food; they thanked the mountain spirit for the gift.
translations.idiomatic: Only seven men had reached the summit and food was running low; they thanked the mountain spirit for the bounty.

sentences.zh: 卻行未里許，欻然霧合。

translations.literal: They had not gone back a full li when suddenly the fog closed in again.
translations.idiomatic: They had scarcely gone a li downhill when the fog shut in again.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，還至前望處，終不復見山光。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day they returned to the place from which they had first looked out, but never again saw the mountain's light.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou they returned to their earlier lookout, yet the mountain's gleam never reappeared.

sentences.zh: 七月庚辰，至恰庫河，馬疲甚。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day of the seventh month they reached the Qiaku River; the horses were utterly exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the seventh month they reached the Qiaku River, their horses spent.

sentences.zh: 甲申，自恰庫河乘舟還，經色克騰、圖伯赫、噶爾漢、噶達渾、薩穆、薩克錫、法克什、多琿諸河，至松花江。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day they boarded boats at the Qiaku River to return, passing the Seketeng, Tubohe, Ga'erhan, Gadahun, Samu, Sakexi, Fakeshi, Duohui, and other rivers until they reached the Songhua.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen they took boats down from the Qiaku, threading the Seketeng, Tubohe, Ga'erhan, Gadahun, Samu, Sakexi, Fakeshi, Duohui, and other streams to the Songhua.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，還吉林，巡視寧古塔諸處。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day of the eighth month they returned to Jilin and inspected the region of Ningguta and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the eighth month they were back at Jilin and toured Ningguta and neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，還京師。

translations.literal: On the yichou day they returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou they reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 疏聞，詔封長白山之神，秩祀如五嶽。

translations.literal: He memorialized the throne; an edict enfeoffed the spirit of Mount Changbai, with sacrificial rank equal to the Five Sacred Peaks.
translations.idiomatic: His memorial reached the throne, and an edict ennobled the spirit of Mount Changbai with rites ranked alongside the Five Sacred Peaks.

sentences.zh: 十七年，命武默訥齎敕往封，歲時望祭如典禮。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Wu Mo'ne was ordered to carry an edict to perform the enfeoffment; seasonal worship on the first and fifteenth followed the prescribed ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 17 he was sent back with an imperial patent to complete the investiture, and thereafter the mountain received the regular calendar of state sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 十九年，召入養心殿，命工繪其像以賜。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was summoned to the Hall of Mental Cultivation and ordered artisans to paint his portrait as a gift.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 19 he was called to the Hall of Mental Cultivation and the emperor had his portrait painted and bestowed.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「以此像俾爾子孫世世供享，以昭恩寵。

translations.literal: An instruction said: "With this portrait let your descendants offer sacrifice generation after generation, to display imperial favor."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him: "Let your descendants enshrine this portrait forever, as a sign of my favor."

sentences.zh: 」二十九年，卒，賜祭葬。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-ninth year he died and was granted state sacrificial rites and burial honors.
translations.idiomatic: " He died in Kangxi 29 and received state funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 舒蘭，納喇氏，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Shulan, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Shulan of the Nara clan came from the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 父敦多哩，官刑部侍郎，兼佐領。

translations.literal: His father Dunduoli served as vice minister of the Ministry of Punishments and also held a company command.
translations.idiomatic: His father Dunduoli was vice minister of punishments and also commanded a banner company.

sentences.zh: 坐鞫總督蔡毓榮罪，附和尚書希福從輕比，奪官，戍黑龍江。

translations.literal: For trying the case of Governor-General Cai Yurong's crime he sided with Minister Xifu in applying a lenient sentence, was stripped of office, and was banished to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: While judging Governor-General Cai Yurong he joined Minister Xifu in urging leniency, lost his post, and was exiled to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 舒蘭自理籓院筆帖式遷主事。

translations.literal: Shulan rose from a clerk of the Court of Colonial Affairs to secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Shulan advanced from a clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs to secretary.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年，從侍郎滿丕、都統烏達禪等，招降巴爾瑚三千餘人，安置察哈爾游牧地，編隸佐領。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi he followed Vice Minister Manpi, Commander-in-Chief Udazan, and others in inducing more than three thousand Barhu to submit, settling them on Chahar pasturelands and registering them under company commanders.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 38 he served under Vice Minister Manpi and Commander-in-Chief Udazan when more than three thousand Barhu surrendered, were settled on Chahar grazing lands, and enrolled under banner companies.

sentences.zh: 未幾，巴爾瑚佐領額克圖叛，戕察哈爾副總管阿必達、驍騎校班第，掠馬駝以遁。

translations.literal: Before long the Barhu company commander Eketu rebelled, killed Chahar deputy commander Abida and brave-rider captain Bandi, seized horses and camels, and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, the Barhu company commander Eketu rebelled, murdered Chahar deputy commander Abida and brave-rider captain Bandi, seized horses and camels, and fled.

sentences.zh: 上命喀爾喀公錫卜推哈坦等率蒙古兵追剿，舒蘭持檄傳示蒙古諸貝勒台吉，並徵察哈爾、厄魯特兵，從烏達禪會剿，擒其渠。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Khalkha Prince Sibutuihatan and others to lead Mongol troops in pursuit; Shulan carried proclamations to the Mongol princes and taiji, also mobilized Chahar and Oirat troops, joined Udazan in the joint campaign, and captured the rebel leader.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Khalkha Prince Sibutuihatan with Mongol cavalry in pursuit. Shulan bore edicts to the Mongol princes and nobles, mustered Chahar and Oirat forces, joined Udazan's punitive column, and took the rebel chief.

sentences.zh: 遷內閣侍讀。

translations.literal: He was transferred to reader in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to reader in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四十年，命偕侍衛拉錫往探河源，諭曰：「河源雖名古爾班索里瑪勒，其發源處人跡罕到。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he was ordered, together with bodyguard Laxi, to explore the Yellow River's source. An edict said: "Although the river's source is called Gurban Suurimale, the place where it rises is seldom reached by men."
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 40 he was sent with bodyguard Laxi to trace the Yellow River to its source. The emperor said: "The source is known as Gurban Suurimale, yet almost no one has reached the place where it actually begins."

sentences.zh: 爾等務窮其源，察視河流自何處入雪山邊內。

translations.literal: You must trace it to the utmost source and observe from what place the river enters the interior beyond the snow mountains.
translations.idiomatic: You must follow it to the end and note where the stream enters the interior beyond the snowy ranges.

sentences.zh: 凡經流諸處，宜詳閱之。

translations.literal: Every place the current passes should be examined in detail."
translations.idiomatic: Survey every stretch it flows through in detail."

sentences.zh: 」四月辛酉，舒蘭等發京師。

translations.literal: " On the xinyou day of the fourth month Shulan and the others set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinyou in the fourth month Shulan's party left the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，至青海。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the fifth month they reached Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the fifth month they reached Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 庚子，至庫庫布拉克。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day they reached Kukubulak.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi they arrived at Kukubulak.

sentences.zh: 貝勒色卜騰扎勒與偕行。

translations.literal: Beile Sebutengzhale traveled with them.
translations.idiomatic: Beile Sebutengzhale accompanied them.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，至鄂棱諾爾。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the sixth month they reached Eling Nur.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the sixth month they reached Lake Eling.

sentences.zh: 甲子，西行至扎棱諾爾。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day they went west to Zhaling Nur.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi they marched west to Lake Zhaling.

sentences.zh: 鄂棱週二百餘裡，扎棱週三百餘裡，二諾爾距三十里許。

translations.literal: Eling's circumference was more than two hundred li, Zhaling's more than three hundred li; the two lakes were about thirty li apart.
translations.idiomatic: Eling measured over two hundred li around, Zhaling over three hundred; the lakes lay some thirty li apart.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，至星宿海，蒙古名「鄂敦塔拉」。

translations.literal: On the yichou day they reached the Sea of Starry Hosts, called in Mongol "Odun Tala."
translations.idiomatic: On yichou they came to the Sea of Starry Hosts, known to Mongols as Odun Tala.

sentences.zh: 星宿海之源，小泉萬億，歷歷如星，眾山環之。

translations.literal: At the source of the Sea of Starry Hosts were myriads of small springs, each distinct as a star, with mountains encircling them.
translations.idiomatic: At the headwaters countless little springs glittered like stars, ringed by mountains.

sentences.zh: 南有山曰古爾班圖勒哈，西南有山曰布瑚珠勒赫，西有山曰巴爾布哈，北有山曰阿克塔齊勒，東北有山曰烏闌都什，蒙古總名曰「庫爾坤」，即崑崙也。

translations.literal: To the south was a mountain called Gurban Tuleha; southwest, Buhuzhu'lehe; west, Ba'erbuha; north, Akta Qile; northeast, Ulandushi. The Mongol collective name was "Kurkun," that is, Kunlun.
translations.idiomatic: South stood Gurban Tuleha; southwest Buhuzhu'lehe; west Ba'erbuha; north Akta Qile; northeast Ulandushi. Mongols called the whole range Kurkun—the Kunlun.

sentences.zh: 山泉出自古爾班圖勒哈者，為噶爾瑪瑭；

translations.literal: The spring from Gurban Tuleha was called Garma Tang;
translations.idiomatic: The stream from Gurban Tuleha was the Garma Tang;

sentences.zh: 出自巴爾布哈者，為噶爾瑪楚木朗；

translations.literal: that from Ba'erbuha was Garma Chumulang;
translations.idiomatic: from Ba'erbuha the Garma Chumulang;

sentences.zh: 出自阿克塔齊勒者，為噶爾瑪沁尼。

translations.literal: that from Akta Qile was Garma Qini.
translations.idiomatic: from Akta Qile the Garma Qini.

sentences.zh: 三山之泉，溢為三支河，即古爾班索里瑪勒也。

translations.literal: The springs of the three mountains overflowed into three branches, which is Gurban Suurimale.
translations.idiomatic: These three mountain springs fed three branches—the Gurban Suurimale itself.

sentences.zh: 三河東流入扎棱諾爾，扎棱一支入鄂棱諾爾，黃河自鄂棱出。

translations.literal: The three rivers flowed east into Zhaling Nur; one branch of Zhaling entered Eling Nur, and the Yellow River issued from Eling.
translations.idiomatic: All three ran east into Zhaling; one arm of Zhaling fed Eling, and the Yellow River issued from Eling.

sentences.zh: 其他山泉與平地水泉，淵淪縈繞，不可勝數，悉歸黃河東下。

translations.literal: Other mountain springs and level-ground springs wound in deep pools beyond counting; all joined the Yellow River flowing east.
translations.idiomatic: Countless other springs from hill and plain pooled and braided together, all feeding the Yellow River eastward.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，舒蘭等自星宿海還，舍故道，循河流東南行。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day Shulan and the others left the Sea of Starry Hosts, abandoned the former route, and followed the river southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao they left the Sea of Starry Hosts, forsook their inbound trail, and tracked the river southeast.

sentences.zh: 己巳，登哈爾吉山，見黃河折而東，至庫庫陀羅海山，又南繞薩楚克山，复北流，經巴爾陀羅海山之南。

translations.literal: On the jisi day they climbed Ha'erji Mountain and saw the Yellow River bend east; reaching Kukutuoluohai Mountain, it turned south around Sachuke Mountain, then flowed north again, passing south of Ba'ertuoluohai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi they climbed Mount Ha'erji and watched the Yellow River bend eastward; at Kukutuoluohai it swung south around Sachuke, then north again past the southern flank of Ba'ertuoluohai.

sentences.zh: 庚午，達阿木尼瑪勒佔穆遜山，山最高，雲霧蔽之，不可端倪。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day they reached Amu Nima Lezhanmuxun Mountain; it was the highest, shrouded in cloud and mist so its limits could not be discerned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu they reached Amu Nima Lezhanmuxun, the loftiest peak, wrapped in cloud so that its full extent could not be seen.

sentences.zh: 蒙古人言長三百餘裡，有九高峰，積冰終古不消。

translations.literal: Mongols said it was more than three hundred li long, with nine lofty peaks whose piled ice never melted through the ages.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols said the range ran more than three hundred li, with nine great summits whose ice never thawed.

sentences.zh: 常雨雪，一月得晴僅三四日。

translations.literal: Snow and rain were constant; in a month there were only three or four clear days.
translations.idiomatic: Snow and rain were almost constant; a month might bring only three or four fair days.

sentences.zh: 舒蘭等自此返。

translations.literal: Shulan and the others returned from this point.
translations.idiomatic: From there Shulan's party turned back.

sentences.zh: 壬申，至錫喇庫特勒，又南過僧庫爾高嶺，更百餘裡，至黃河岸。

translations.literal: On the renshen day they reached Xilakuteli, then went south over Sengku'er Gaoling, and after another hundred-odd li reached the Yellow River bank.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen they reached Xilakuteli, crossed Sengku'er Pass to the south, and after another hundred li came to the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 見黃河自巴爾陀羅海山東北流，經歸德堡北、達喀山南兩山峽中，流入蘭州。

translations.literal: They saw the Yellow River flow northeast from Ba'ertuoluohai Mountain, pass north of Guide Fort and through the gorge between two mountains south of Daka Mountain, and enter Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: They traced the river northeast from Ba'ertuoluohai, through the gorge north of Guide and south of Daka, on into Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 自京師至星宿海，七千六百餘裡。

translations.literal: From the capital to the Sea of Starry Hosts was more than seven thousand six hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: The capital lay more than seven thousand six hundred li from the Sea of Starry Hosts.

sentences.zh: 寧夏西自松山至星宿海，天氣漸低，地勢漸高，人氣閉塞，行多喘息。

translations.literal: West of Ningxia from Songshan to the Sea of Starry Hosts the air grew thinner, the terrain higher, men's breath was stifled, and travelers often gasped.
translations.idiomatic: West of Ningxia, from Songshan to the Sea of Starry Hosts, the air thinned and the land rose; travelers labored for breath.

sentences.zh: 九月，還京師，具疏述所經，並繪圖以進。

translations.literal: In the ninth month they returned to the capital, submitted a memorial detailing the route, and presented maps.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month they returned to the capital, memorialized their route in full, and submitted maps.

sentences.zh: 上諭廷臣曰：「朕於古今山川名號，雖在邊徼遐荒，必詳考圖籍，廣詢方言，務得其正。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed the court: "In ancient and modern place-names for mountains and rivers, even in remote borderlands, I must examine maps and records in detail, inquire widely into local speech, and strive for correctness."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the court: "Whether a river or mountain lies in the heartland or the farthest marches, I study the maps, question local names, and insist on getting them right."

sentences.zh: 故遣使至崑崙，目擊詳求，載入輿圖。

translations.literal: Therefore I sent envoys to Kunlun to investigate on the spot and enter the findings in the imperial atlas.
translations.idiomatic: That is why I sent men to Kunlun to see for themselves and record what they found on the imperial maps.

sentences.zh: 即如黃河源出西塞外庫爾坤山之東，眾泉渙散，燦如列星，蒙古謂之'鄂敦塔拉'，西番謂之'索里瑪勒'，中華謂之'星宿海'，是為河源。

translations.literal: Take the Yellow River: its source lies east of Kurkun Mountain beyond the western passes. Myriad springs scatter and gleam like stars in array. Mongols call it "Odun Tala," Tibetans "Suurimale," and Chinese "the Sea of Starry Hosts"—this is the river's source.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River rises east of Kurkun beyond the western frontier, where countless springs glitter like stars. Mongols call it Odun Tala, Tibetans Suurimale, Chinese the Sea of Starry Hosts—that is the source.

sentences.zh: 彙為扎棱、鄂棱二澤。

translations.literal: They gather into the two lakes Zhaling and Eling.
translations.idiomatic: The waters gather in the twin lakes Zhaling and Eling.

sentences.zh: 東南行，折北，復東行，由歸德堡、積石關入蘭州，其原委可得而縷晰也。

translations.literal: Flowing southeast, bending north, then east again, it passes Guide Fort and Jishi Pass into Lanzhou; its course can now be traced strand by strand.
translations.idiomatic: It runs southeast, turns north, then east again through Guide and Jishi Pass into Lanzhou—its entire course can now be traced in detail.

sentences.zh: 舒蘭累擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: Shulan was promoted in stages to grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Shulan rose step by step to grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，命往西藏封拉藏為翊法恭順汗。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year he was ordered to Tibet to enfeoff Lozang as Yifa Gongshun Khan.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 45 he was sent to Tibet to invest Lozang as Yifa Gongshun Khan.

sentences.zh: 回京得風疾，遣太醫診視。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital he contracted a wind ailment; imperial physicians were sent to treat him.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the capital he suffered a stroke; court physicians were dispatched to attend him.

sentences.zh: 越二年，疾復發，乞休，許解任調治。

translations.literal: After two years the illness recurred; he begged to retire and was permitted to leave office to recuperate.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later the illness returned; he asked to retire and was allowed to leave office to recover.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，疾愈，起故官。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year, when he had recovered, he was restored to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 52, cured, he was recalled to his former post.

sentences.zh: 是年以萬壽恩典，復其父敦多哩故秩。

translations.literal: That year, by the grace of the Longevity celebration, his father Dunduoli's former rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: That year the emperor's birthday amnesty restored his father Dunduoli's former rank.

sentences.zh: 尋遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon after he was transferred to vice minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 未幾，坐事，降三秩調用。

translations.literal: Before long, for an offense, he was demoted three ranks and reassigned.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was implicated in a case, demoted three ranks, and transferred.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 59.

sentences.zh: 拉錫，圖伯特氏，蒙古正白旗人。

translations.literal: Laxi, of the Tubote clan, was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Laxi of the Tubote clan belonged to the Mongol Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自親軍校三遷二等侍衛，偕舒蘭窮河源，進一等。

translations.literal: From personal guard corporal he was promoted three times to second-rank bodyguard; together with Shulan he traced the river source to the end and was advanced to first rank.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from personal guard corporal through three promotions to second-rank bodyguard; with Shulan he traced the Yellow River to its source and was raised to first rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，累擢本旗都統。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng he was promoted in stages to commander-in-chief of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongzheng reign he became commander-in-chief of his banner.

sentences.zh: 以治事明敏，予拜他喇布勒哈番世職，授議政大臣。

translations.literal: For clear and keen administration he was granted the hereditary rank of baitalabulehafan and appointed deliberative minister.
translations.idiomatic: His sharp administration won him the hereditary baitalabulehafan rank and a seat among the deliberative ministers.

sentences.zh: 拉錫諳習旗務，奏事輒稱旨，累被褒嘉，加授拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Laxi was well versed in banner affairs; his memorials always met with approval, he was repeatedly praised, and was additionally granted dorosahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Laxi knew banner administration inside out; his reports always pleased the throne, he was repeatedly commended, and received an additional dorosahafan rank.

sentences.zh: 四年，以隱匿烏梁海事，盡削官職，降授一等侍衛，管太僕寺卿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, for concealing Wuliangha affairs, all his offices were stripped; he was demoted to first-rank bodyguard and placed in charge of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 he was stripped of every post for concealing Wuliangha matters, reduced to first-rank bodyguard, and put in charge of the imperial stud.

sentences.zh: 尋仍擢鑲白旗滿洲都統，迭署江寧將軍、天津滿洲水師營都統，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Soon after he was again promoted to commander-in-chief of the Bordered White Banner Manchus, served in succession as acting Jiangning general and commander of the Tianjin Manchu naval camp, and was appointed leading bodyguard grand minister of the interior.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon raised again to commander-in-chief of the Bordered White Banner Manchus, acted successively as Jiangning general and commander of the Tianjin Manchu naval camp, and became a leading bodyguard grand minister of the interior.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 子旺札爾，初授侍衛，襲世職。

translations.literal: His son Wangzhar was first appointed bodyguard and inherited the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wangzhar entered service as a bodyguard and inherited the family rank.

sentences.zh: 使從侍郎阿克敦與噶爾丹定界。

translations.literal: As envoy he followed Vice Minister Akedun in delimiting the border with Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as envoy under Vice Minister Akedun in fixing the border with Galdan.

sentences.zh: 如蘇州、如浙江按事。

translations.literal: He conducted investigations like those at Suzhou and in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He conducted investigations on the Suzhou and Zhejiang models.

sentences.zh: 累遷鑲白旗滿洲都統、理籓院侍郎、御前大臣。

translations.literal: He was promoted in stages to commander-in-chief of the Bordered White Banner Manchus, vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, and grand minister in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to commander-in-chief of the Bordered White Banner Manchus, vice minister of colonial affairs, and grand minister in attendance.

sentences.zh: 命赴金川察沿途驛站。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go to Jinchuan to inspect relay stations along the route.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to Jinchuan to inspect the relay stations along the route.

sentences.zh: 金川平，擢領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified he was promoted to leading bodyguard grand minister of the interior.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jinchuan campaign he was made leading bodyguard grand minister of the interior.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡恪慎。

translations.literal: He died and was given the posthumous title Kezhen (Respectful and Cautious).
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously titled Kezhen (Respectful and Cautious).

sentences.zh: 孫博靈阿，襲世職。

translations.literal: His grandson Boling'a inherited the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Boling'a inherited the hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 初授侍衛，累遷正藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was first appointed bodyguard and was promoted in stages to deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a bodyguard and rose to deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 從征金川，攻當噶爾拉，撲碉受創，卒。

translations.literal: Campaigning in Jinchuan, he assaulted Dangga'erla, stormed a blockhouse, was wounded, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jinchuan campaign he attacked Dangga'erla, stormed a blockhouse, was wounded, and died.

sentences.zh: 贈都統銜，進世職一等輕車都尉，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted the rank of commander-in-chief, his hereditary office was advanced to first-class commandant of light chariots, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Glaze.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously given commander-in-chief rank, his hereditary office was raised to first-class commandant of light chariots, and his portrait was enshrined in the Hall of Purple Glaze.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十七年，高宗命侍衛阿彌達詣西寧祭河神，再窮河源。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year of Qianlong the Gaozong Emperor ordered bodyguard Amita to go to Xining to sacrifice to the river god and again trace the Yellow River to its source.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 47 the Gaozong Emperor sent bodyguard Amita to Xining to sacrifice to the river god and once more trace the Yellow River to its source.

sentences.zh: 還奏：「星宿海西南有水名阿勒坦郭勒，更西有巨石高數丈，名阿勒坦噶達素齊老。

translations.literal: On his return he memorialized: "Southwest of the Sea of Starry Hosts is a stream called Altan Gol; farther west is a boulder several zhang high called Altan Kadak Su Qilao.
translations.idiomatic: He reported on his return: "Southwest of the Sea of Starry Hosts lies a stream called Altan Gol; farther west stands a boulder several zhang high named Altan Kadak Su Qilao.

sentences.zh: 蒙古語'阿勒坦'為黃金，'噶達素'為北極星，'郭勒'為河，'齊老'石也。

translations.literal: In Mongol 'Altan' means gold, 'Kadak Su' the pole star, 'Gol' a river, and 'Qilao' a stone.
translations.idiomatic: In Mongol, altan means gold, kadak su the pole star, gol a river, and qilao a stone.

sentences.zh: 崖壁黃金色，上有池，池中泉噴湧，釃為百道，皆黃金色。

translations.literal: The cliff face was golden in color; above was a pool whose springs gushed forth, dividing into a hundred channels, all golden in hue.
translations.idiomatic: Golden cliffs rose above a pool whose springs burst forth in a hundred golden channels.

sentences.zh: 入阿勒坦郭勒，迴旋三百餘裡，入星宿海，為黃河真源。

translations.literal: Entering the Altan Gol, winding more than three hundred li, it joins the Sea of Starry Hosts—this is the true source of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Altan Gol winds more than three hundred li into the Sea of Starry Hosts—the true source of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 」高宗命四庫館諸臣輯河源紀略識其事。

translations.literal: " The Gaozong Emperor ordered scholars of the Siku project to compile the He Yuan Ji Lue to record the matter.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered the Siku scholars to compile the He Yuan Ji Lue to record the finding.

sentences.zh: 阿彌達更名阿必達。

translations.literal: Amita was renamed Abida.
translations.idiomatic: Amita was renamed Abida.

sentences.zh: 大學士阿桂子，附見阿桂傳。

translations.literal: He was the son of Grand Secretary Agui; see Agui's biography.
translations.idiomatic: He was the son of Grand Secretary Agui; see the biography of Agui.

sentences.zh: 圖理琛，阿顏覺羅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Tulichen, of the Ayanggioro clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Tulichen of the Ayanggioro clan belonged to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 以國子生考授內閣中書，遷侍讀。

translations.literal: As a student of the Imperial Academy he passed examination and was appointed secretary in the Grand Secretariat, then transferred to reader.
translations.idiomatic: A graduate of the Imperial Academy, he was appointed Grand Secretariat secretary and then reader.

sentences.zh: 坐事，奪職。

translations.literal: For an offense he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: He lost his post for an offense.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十一年，特命復職，出使土爾扈特。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year of Kangxi he was specially ordered restored to office and sent as envoy to the Torghut.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 51 he was specially restored and sent as envoy to the Torghut.

sentences.zh: 初，土爾扈特汗阿玉奇從子阿喇布珠爾，假道準噶爾赴西藏謁達賴喇嘛。

translations.literal: Earlier, Ayuki Khan of the Torghut's nephew Alabuzhur, taking the route through Dzungaria, went to Tibet to pay homage to the Dalai Lama.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Torghut khan Ayuki's nephew Alabuzhur had traveled through Dzungaria to Tibet to pay homage to the Dalai Lama.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾台吉策妄阿喇布坦與阿玉奇構怨，阿喇布珠爾不得歸，款關乞內屬，詔封貝子，賜牧嘉峪關外黨色爾騰。

translations.literal: The Dzungar taiji Tsewang Arabtan bore a grudge against Ayuki; Alabuzhur could not return, came to the frontier seeking to submit, was enfeoffed as beile, and was granted pasture outside Jiayuguan at Dangsileten.
translations.idiomatic: Dzungar taiji Tsewang Arabtan was at odds with Ayuki; Alabuzhur could not return, sought entry at the frontier, was enfeoffed as beile, and was pastured outside Jiayuguan at Dangsileten.

sentences.zh: 嗣阿玉奇遣使入貢，上欲歸阿喇布珠爾。

translations.literal: Later Ayuki sent envoys to pay tribute; the emperor wished to return Alabuzhur.
translations.idiomatic: When Ayuki later sent tribute envoys, the emperor wished to send Alabuzhur back.

sentences.zh: 命圖理琛偕侍讀學士殷扎納、郎中納顏齎敕諭阿玉奇，假道鄂羅斯。

translations.literal: Tulichen was ordered, together with Reader-Compiler Yinzhana and Director Nayin, to carry an edict to Ayuki, taking the route through Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Tulichen was ordered with Reader-Compiler Yinzhana and Director Nayin to carry an edict to Ayuki by way of Russia.

sentences.zh: 五月，圖理琛等自京師啟行，七月，至鄂羅斯境楚庫柏興。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Tulichen and the others set out from the capital; in the seventh month they reached Chukubergen on Russian territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Tulichen's party left the capital; in the seventh month they reached Chukubergen in Russia.

sentences.zh: 以假道故，待其國察罕汗進止。

translations.literal: Because they were borrowing the route, they awaited the Russian tsar's decision.
translations.idiomatic: As they traveled by permission, they waited on the Russian tsar's orders.

sentences.zh: 五十二年正月，許假道，乃行。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifty-second year passage was granted and they set out.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Kangxi 52 permission was granted and they departed.

sentences.zh: 還烏的柏興，越柏海爾湖而北，抵厄爾庫。

translations.literal: They returned to Udinsk, crossed Lake Baikal northward, and reached Irkutsk.
translations.idiomatic: They returned to Udinsk, crossed Lake Baikal to the north, and reached Irkutsk.

sentences.zh: 鄂羅斯託波爾噶噶林遣其屬博爾科尼來迎。

translations.literal: The Russian Tobolsk governor-general sent his subordinate Bolkoni to welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: The Tobolsk governor-general sent his man Bolkoni to meet them.

sentences.zh: 噶噶林者，彼國所稱總管也。

translations.literal: Gagalin is what that country calls its chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Gagalin was their title for chief administrator.

sentences.zh: 圖理琛等欲行，博爾科尼言噶噶林令天使當自水路行，而昂噶拉河冰未泮，請稍駐俟之。

translations.literal: When Tulichen and the others wished to proceed, Bolkoni said the governor-general ordered the envoys to travel by water, but the Angara was still frozen; they were asked to wait a little.
translations.idiomatic: When they wished to move on, Bolkoni said the governor-general required them to travel by water, but the Angara had not thawed; they must wait.

sentences.zh: 三月，自昂噶拉河乘舟抵伊聶謝柏興，登陸。

translations.literal: In the third month they took boats on the Angara to Yeniseisk and went ashore.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month they boated down the Angara to Yeniseisk and went ashore.

sentences.zh: 五月，抵麻科斯科，复乘舟自揭的河順流行，經那裡穆柏興、蘇爾呼特柏興、薩瑪爾斯科、狄穆演斯科諸地。

translations.literal: In the fifth month they reached Makovsk; again they took boats down the Ket River, passing Narym, Surgut, Samar, and Demyansk.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month they reached Makovsk, then boated down the Ket past Narym, Surgut, Samar, and Demyansk.

sentences.zh: 七月，至託波爾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month they reached Tobol.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they reached Tobol.

sentences.zh: 其地噶噶林名馬提飛費多里魚赤，迎至廨，留八日。

translations.literal: The local governor-general was named Matifeidoriyuchi; he welcomed them to his office and detained them eight days.
translations.idiomatic: The local governor-general Matifeidoriyuchi received them at his office and kept them eight days.

sentences.zh: 仍遣博爾科尼護之行，抵鴉班沁登陸。

translations.literal: He again sent Bolkoni to escort them; they landed at Yabanchi.
translations.idiomatic: Bolkoni escorted them again; they landed at Yabanchi.

sentences.zh: 自費耶爾和土爾斯科越佛落克嶺，抵索里喀穆斯科，以路濘，守凍十日。

translations.literal: From Verkhoturye they crossed the Volga ridge to Solikamsk; the roads were mired and they waited out the freeze ten days.
translations.idiomatic: From Verkhoturye they crossed the Volga ridge to Solikamsk; the roads were impassable and they waited ten days for the freeze.

sentences.zh: 復行，經改郭羅多、黑林諾付、喀山、西穆必爾斯科諸地。

translations.literal: They traveled on, passing Gaigoluo, Heilinuofu, Kazan, and Simbirsk.
translations.idiomatic: They went on through Gaigoluo, Heilinuofu, Kazan, and Simbirsk.

sentences.zh: 十一月，至薩拉託付，是為鄂羅斯與土爾扈特界。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month they reached Saratov, which was the border between Russia and the Torghut.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month they reached Saratov, the Russo-Torghut frontier.

sentences.zh: 水自東北來，折而南，鄂羅斯號為佛爾格，土爾扈特號為額濟勒。

translations.literal: Water came from the northeast and bent south; the Russians called it Volga, the Torghut Ejin.
translations.idiomatic: A river came from the northeast and turned south; Russians called it the Volga, the Torghut the Ejin.

sentences.zh: 阿玉奇汗駐牧地曰瑪努託海，距此十日程，以雪盛不能行。

translations.literal: Ayuki Khan's pasture was called Manutohai, ten days' journey from here; heavy snow prevented travel.
translations.idiomatic: Ayuki's camp at Manutohai lay ten days away, but deep snow blocked the road.

sentences.zh: 五十三年四月，阿玉奇遣台吉祥偉徵等來迎。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifty-third year Ayuki sent the taiji Weizheng and others to welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Kangxi 53 Ayuki sent taiji Weizheng and others to meet them.

sentences.zh: 五月，圖理琛等渡額濟勒河，阿喇布珠爾之父納扎爾瑪穆特遣獻馬，卻之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Tulichen and the others crossed the Ejin River; Alabuzhur's father Nazhalmamut sent horses as gifts, which they declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month they crossed the Ejin; Alabuzhur's father Nazhalmamut offered horses, which they refused.

sentences.zh: 六年朔，至瑪努託海，阿玉奇擇日聽宣敕。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month they reached Manutohai; Ayuki chose a day to hear the edict read.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month they reached Manutohai; Ayuki chose a day to receive the edict.

sentences.zh: 圖理琛等以上意諭之曰：「阿喇布珠爾已賜爵優養，欲遣歸爾牧地，以策妄阿喇布坦方與爾交惡，恐為所戕。

translations.literal: Tulichen and the others conveyed the imperial will, saying: "Alabuzhur has been granted rank and generous support; we wish to send him back to your pastures, but as Tsewang Arabtan is now at enmity with you, we fear he may be killed.
translations.idiomatic: Tulichen conveyed the emperor's words: "Alabuzhur has been ennobled and richly maintained; we wish to return him to your pastures, but Tsewang Arabtan is your enemy and may kill him.

sentences.zh: 爾若欲令阿喇布珠爾歸，當自鄂羅斯來迎。

translations.literal: If you wish Alabuzhur to return, you should come to meet him through Russia.
translations.idiomatic: If you want him back, you must fetch him through Russia.

sentences.zh: 」阿玉奇曰：「我雖外夷，然冠服與中國同。

translations.literal: " Ayuki said: "Though I am an outer barbarian, my dress is the same as China's.
translations.idiomatic: " Ayuki replied: "I may be a foreigner, but my dress is China's.

sentences.zh: 鄂羅斯乃嗜慾不同、言語不通之國也，天使歸道當察其情狀。

translations.literal: Russia is a land of different appetites and unintelligible speech; on your return you should observe its condition.
translations.idiomatic: Russia is a land of alien desires and speech; observe it on your way home.

sentences.zh: 鄂羅斯若以往來數故不假道，則我無由入貢矣。

translations.literal: If Russia, citing past traffic, refuses passage, I shall have no way to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: If Russia refuses passage because of past traffic, I cannot send tribute.

sentences.zh: 阿喇布珠爾荷厚恩，與歸土爾扈特同，復何疑慮？

translations.literal: Alabuzhur owes deep grace; returning to the Torghut is the same—what doubt remains?
translations.idiomatic: Alabuzhur owes great favor; his return is the same as ours—what doubt is there?

sentences.zh: 」阿玉奇及納扎爾瑪穆特等各贈馬及方物，圖理琛等以越境無私交，卻不受。

translations.literal: " Ayuki and Nazhalmamut and the others each presented horses and local products; Tulichen and the others, holding that beyond the border there should be no private dealings, declined them.
translations.idiomatic: " Ayuki, Nazhalmamut, and others offered horses and gifts; Tulichen refused private dealings beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 阿玉奇待之有隆禮，留十四日，筵宴不絕。

translations.literal: Ayuki received them with great ceremony, kept them fourteen days, and feasting was unceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Ayuki entertained them lavishly for fourteen days without pause.

sentences.zh: 复附表奏謝。

translations.literal: He also submitted a memorial of thanks.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent a memorial of thanks.

sentences.zh: 圖理琛等遂行，由舊路歸，鄂羅斯遣護如初。

translations.literal: Tulichen and the others then departed, returning by the former route; Russia sent escorts as before.
translations.idiomatic: They returned by the same route with Russian escorts as before.

sentences.zh: 五十四年三月，還京師。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifty-fourth year they returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Kangxi 54 they reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 是役也，往返三載餘，經行數万裡。

translations.literal: This mission lasted more than three years going and coming, traversing tens of thousands of li.
translations.idiomatic: The mission lasted over three years and covered tens of thousands of li.

sentences.zh: 蓋土爾扈特為鄂羅斯所隔，遠阻聲教，而鄂羅斯又故導我使紆道行。

translations.literal: The Torghut were cut off by Russia, far from imperial influence, and Russia deliberately led our envoys by a circuitous route.
translations.idiomatic: The Torghut were isolated by Russia, far from the court's reach, and Russia deliberately sent the envoys by a detour.

sentences.zh: 圖理琛奉使無辱命，既歸國，入對，述往還事狀，並撰異域錄，首冠輿圖，次為行記，呈上覽。

translations.literal: Tulichen fulfilled his mission without disgrace; on returning he had audience, described the journey, and compiled the Yiyu Lu, placing maps first and a travel narrative second, and presented it for the emperor's inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Tulichen discharged his commission honorably; on return he reported the journey and compiled the Yiyu Lu with maps first and a travel narrative second.

sentences.zh: 上嘉悅，尋授兵部員外郎。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased and soon appointed him secretary in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased and soon made him a secretary in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 阿喇布珠爾亦遂留牧黨色爾騰不復遣，再傳至其子丹忠，雍正中，遷牧額濟內河。

translations.literal: Alabuzhur also remained pasturing at Dangsileten and was not sent back; passed down to his son Danzhong, who in the Yongzheng period was moved to pasture on the Ejin River.
translations.idiomatic: Alabuzhur stayed at Dangsileten; his line passed to Danzhong, moved in the Yongzheng era to the Ejin River.

sentences.zh: 圖理琛遷郎中。

translations.literal: Tulichen was transferred to director.
translations.idiomatic: Tulichen became a director.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，命赴廣東察籓庫，就擢廣東布政使。

translations.literal: When Shizong took the throne he was ordered to Guangdong to inspect the treasury and was thereupon promoted provincial administration commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: At Shizong's accession he inspected the Guangdong treasury and was promoted provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 調陝西。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 三年，擢巡撫。

translations.literal: In the third year he was promoted governor.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 he became governor.

sentences.zh: 五年，召為兵部侍郎，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was summoned as vice minister of war and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 he was recalled as vice minister of war, then transferred to personnel.

sentences.zh: 偕喀爾喀郡王額駙策淩等往定喀爾喀與鄂羅斯界。

translations.literal: Together with Khalkha prince consort Tsering and others he went to fix the border between Khalkha and Russia.
translations.idiomatic: With Khalkha prince consort Tsering he delimited the Khalkha-Russian border.

sentences.zh: 仍調兵部。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 六年，追議前定界時，與鄂羅斯使臣薩瓦鳴砲謝天，私立木牌，並擅納鄂羅斯貿易人入界；

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on review of the earlier border delimitation, it was charged that with the Russian envoy Sava he fired cannon to thank Heaven, privately erected wooden markers, and without authority admitted Russian traders across the border;
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 6 a review of the border mission charged that with the Russian envoy Sava he fired cannon to thank Heaven, set up private markers, and admitted Russian traders without authority;

sentences.zh: 又前任陝西巡撫時，將天下兵數繕摺私給將軍延信，逮問論斬。

translations.literal: and while previously governor of Shaanxi he had copied out the empire's troop numbers on a folded memorial and privately gave it to General Yanxin; he was arrested, tried, and sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: and as Shaanxi governor had privately given General Yanxin a memorial listing empire-wide troop strengths; he was arrested and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 詔宥免，遣築扎克拜達里克城。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned him and sent him to build Zakhbaydarik walled town.
translations.idiomatic: He was pardoned and sent to build Zakhbaydarik.

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，授內閣學士，遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Gaozong took the throne he was appointed grand secretary and transferred to vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: At Gaozong's accession he became grand secretary, then vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，以老解侍郎任，仍為內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, on account of age he was relieved of the vice ministership but remained grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1, owing to age, he left the vice ministership but kept his grand secretary seat.

sentences.zh: 二年，引疾去。

translations.literal: In the second year he resigned citing illness.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2 he retired on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Qianlong 5.

sentences.zh: 何國宗，字翰如，順天大興人。

translations.literal: He Guozong, style name Hanru, was a native of Daxing in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: He Guozong, styled Hanru, came from Daxing in Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十一年進士，改庶吉士，命直內廷學算法。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the fifty-first year of Kangxi, he became a bachelor of the Hanlin Academy and was ordered to study mathematics in the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: He took his jinshi in Kangxi 51, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and was set to study mathematics in the inner court.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，命編輯律曆淵源。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year he was ordered to edit the Luli Yuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 52 he was ordered to edit the Luli Yuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 未散館，授編修。

translations.literal: Before leaving the academy he was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Before leaving the academy he was made a compiler.

sentences.zh: 三遷至庶子。

translations.literal: He was promoted three times to sub-reader.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through three promotions to sub-reader.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，授侍讀學士，再遷至內閣學士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng he was appointed reader-compiler, then promoted twice to grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yongzheng he became reader-compiler, then grand secretary after two promotions.

sentences.zh: 三年，命視黃、運河道，奏請增築戴村石壩，疏濬東昌城南七里河、城北魏家灣及德州城南減河；

translations.literal: In the third year he was ordered to inspect the Yellow River and Grand Canal waterways and memorialized requesting reinforcement of the Dai Village stone dam and dredging of the Seven-li River south of Dongchang, Weijiawan north of the city, and the reduction channel south of Dezhou;
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 he inspected the Yellow River and Grand Canal and proposed strengthening the Dai Village stone dam and dredging the Seven-li River south of Dongchang, Weijiawan north of the city, and Dezhou's southern reduction channel;

sentences.zh: 又以汶、泗泉源紆遠，請專設管泉通判；

translations.literal: and because the sources of the Wen and Si were distant and winding, he requested a dedicated sub-prefect to manage the springs;
translations.idiomatic: because the Wen and Si sources were remote, he asked for a sub-prefect devoted to the springs;

sentences.zh: 又請修高家堰石堤。

translations.literal: and he also requested repair of the stone embankment at Gaojia Embankment.
translations.idiomatic: he also proposed repairing the stone dike at Gaojia Embankment.

sentences.zh: 上皆允其請，並以高家堰石堤工衝要，命發帑興修。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all his requests, and because the Gaojia stone work was critical, ordered funds disbursed for construction.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all requests and, as the Gaojia stone work was vital, ordered treasury funds for the repair.

sentences.zh: 復奏言：「運河自臨清以上，賴衛水以濟。

translations.literal: He further memorialized: "Above Linqing the Grand Canal relies on the Wei River to supply it.
translations.idiomatic: He added: "Above Linqing the canal depends on the Wei River.

sentences.zh: 衛水發源百泉，益以丹、洹二水，其流始盛。

translations.literal: The Wei rises at the Hundred Springs, augmented by the Dan and Huan, and only then does its current grow strong.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei rises at the Hundred Springs and is swelled by the Dan and Huan.

sentences.zh: 請疏百泉為三渠，洹河亦筑壩開渠引水，一分灌田，三分濟運。

translations.literal: He requested dredging the Hundred Springs into three channels and building dams on the Huan to open channels—one part for irrigation, three parts for transport.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed dividing the Hundred Springs into three channels and damming the Huan to divert water—one share for fields, three for transport.

sentences.zh: 」上從其議。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed his proposal.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 旋以山東巡撫塞楞額奏言國宗等奉使所經州縣，供億白金七千六百有奇。

translations.literal: Soon Shandong governor Saileng'e memorialized that the counties Guozong passed on his mission had supplied more than seven thousand six hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Shandong governor Saileng'e reported that counties on Guozong's tour had supplied more than seven thousand six hundred taels.

sentences.zh: 上責國宗不惜物力，負任使，坐降調。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Guozong for not sparing material resources and failing his commission, and he was demoted and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor blamed Guozong for waste and failure of duty and demoted him.

sentences.zh: 五年，授大理寺卿。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed president of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 he became president of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 六年，复擢內閣學士，遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was again promoted to grand secretary and transferred to vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 6 he was again made grand secretary and vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 八年，命與侍郎牛鈕督修北運河減水壩，並濬引河。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered with Vice Minister Niuniu to supervise repair of flood-release dams on the Northern Canal and dredging of diversion channels.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 8 he and Vice Minister Niuniu supervised flood-release dams on the Northern Canal and dredging of diversion channels.

sentences.zh: 國宗等議捍護河西務北堤及耍兒渡魚鱗壩，別開塌河淀下流賈家沽洩水河，建築三里淺、筐兒港、張家莊諸處挑水壩，上命如議速行。

translations.literal: Guozong and others proposed protecting the north embankment north of Hexiwu and the Yao'erdu fish-scale dam, opening a discharge channel at Jiajiagu below Tahe Lake, and building diversion dams at Sanliqian, Kuang'ergang, and Zhangjiazhuang; the emperor ordered these carried out swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: They proposed protecting the north bank at Hexiwu and the Yao'erdu fish-scale dam, opening a discharge at Jiajiagu below Tahe Lake, and diversion dams at Sanliqian, Kuang'ergang, and Zhangjiazhuang; the emperor ordered swift action.

sentences.zh: 九年，兼河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was additionally appointed governor-general of the Hedong waterways.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9 he was also made governor-general of the Hedong waterways.

sentences.zh: 田文鏡奏戴村初建玲瓏、亂石、滾水三壩。

translations.literal: Tian Wenjing memorialized that at Dai Village the Linglong, Luanshi, and Gunshui dams had first been built.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Wenjing reported that Dai Village had first been given the Linglong, Luanshi, and Gunshui dams.

sentences.zh: 汶水盛漲，自壩面流入鹽河歸海。

translations.literal: When the Wen River swelled, water flowed over the dam face into the Salt River and out to sea.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wen flooded, water spilled over the dam into the Salt River and to the sea.

sentences.zh: 國宗等增築石壩，水不能過，瀕河連年被患。

translations.literal: Guozong and the others added a stone dam; water could not pass, and districts along the river suffered flood damage year after year.
translations.idiomatic: Guozong built up the stone dam until the water could not pass, and riverside districts flooded year after year.

sentences.zh: 請毀石壩，復為亂石、滾水壩。

translations.literal: They requested destroying the stone dam and restoring the Luanshi and Gunshui dams.
translations.idiomatic: They asked to tear down the stone dam and restore the Luanshi and Gunshui structures.

sentences.zh: 上責國宗勘工錯誤，貽害民間，奪官。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Guozong for errors in surveying the works that harmed the people, and stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor blamed Guozong for faulty surveying that harmed the people and removed him from office.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，起充算學館、律呂館總裁。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong he was recalled to serve as chief compiler of the Mathematics Institute and the Pitch-Pipes Institute.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianlong he was recalled as chief compiler of the Mathematics and Pitch-Pipes institutes.

sentences.zh: 九年，賜秩視三品。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was granted rank equivalent to third grade.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 9 he was granted third-grade rank.

sentences.zh: 尋授左副都御史。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed left vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made left vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十年，兼領飲天監正。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he additionally served as director of the Imperial Astronomical Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 10 he also became director of the Imperial Astronomical Bureau.

sentences.zh: 十三年，遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 he became vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，聖祖命製皇輿全覽圖，以天度定準望，一度當二百里，遣使如奉天，循行混同、鴨綠二江，至朝鮮分界處，測繪為圖。

translations.literal: During Kangxi the Sagely Ancestor ordered the compilation of the Complete Imperial Atlas, fixing sighting lines by celestial degrees with one degree equal to two hundred li, and sent envoys such as to Fengtian to follow the Hun-tong and Yalu rivers to the Korean border and survey maps.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kangxi era the emperor ordered the Complete Imperial Atlas, using celestial degrees as sighting lines at two hundred li per degree, and sent men from Fengtian along the Hun-tong and Yalu to the Korean border to survey.

sentences.zh: 以鴨綠、圖門二江間未詳晰，五十年，命烏喇總管穆克登偕按事部員復往詳察。

translations.literal: Because the stretch between the Yalu and Tumen was not clear, in the fiftieth year he ordered Ula commander Mukedeng, together with ministry officials on mission, to go again for detailed inspection.
translations.idiomatic: As the Yalu-Tumen stretch remained unclear, in Kangxi 50 he sent Ula commander Mukedeng with ministry officials to inspect again.

sentences.zh: 國宗弟國棟亦以通曆法直內廷。

translations.literal: Guozong's younger brother Guodong also, knowing calendrical methods, served in the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: Guozong's brother Guodong, versed in calendrics, also served in the inner court.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，命國棟等周歷江以南諸行省，測北極高度及日景。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year Guodong and others were ordered to tour the provinces south of the Yangtze, measuring polar altitude and solar shadow.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 53 Guodong and others were sent through the provinces south of the Yangtze to measure polar altitude and the sun's shadow.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，圖成，為全圖一，離合凡三十二幀，別為分省圖，省各一幀。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year the map was completed: one complete map in thirty-two assembled sheets, and separate provincial maps, one sheet per province.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 58 the map was finished—thirty-two sheets for the whole realm and one sheet per province.

sentences.zh: 命蔣廷錫示群臣，諭曰：「朕費三十餘年心力，始得告成。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Jiang Tingxi to show it to the ministers and instructed: "I spent more than thirty years of effort before it could be announced complete.
translations.idiomatic: He had Jiang Tingxi show it to the ministers and said: "I spent more than thirty years before this could be completed.

sentences.zh: 山脈水道，俱與禹貢合。

translations.literal: Mountain ranges and waterways all accord with the Yu Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Its mountains and rivers match the Yu Gong throughout.

sentences.zh: 爾以此與九卿詳閱，如有不合處，九卿有知者，舉出奏明。

translations.literal: Take this and examine it carefully with the Nine Ministers; if anything does not fit and any minister knows of it, bring it forward in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Study it with the Nine Ministers; wherever it errs, let those who know report it.

sentences.zh: 」乃鐫以銅版，藏內府。

translations.literal: " It was then engraved on copper plates and stored in the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: " It was engraved on copper plates and kept in the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 高宗既定準噶爾，乾隆二十一年，命國宗偕侍衛努克三、哈清阿率欽天監西洋人往伊犁，自巴里坤分西北兩路，測天度繪圖。

translations.literal: After the Gaozong Emperor had pacified Dzungaria, in the twenty-first year of Qianlong he ordered Guozong, together with bodyguards Nukesan and Haqing'a, to lead Westerners of the Astronomical Bureau to Ili; from Barkul they divided into northwest routes to measure celestial degrees and survey maps.
translations.idiomatic: After Dzungaria was pacified, in Qianlong 21 he sent Guozong with bodyguards Nukesan and Haqing'a and Bureau astronomers to Ili; from Barkul they split northwest and west to measure degrees and survey.

sentences.zh: 既還報，命署左都御史。

translations.literal: On their return and report he was ordered to act as left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On their return he was ordered to act as left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，授禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was appointed minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 22 he became minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 以京察舉弟國棟，​​坐徇庇，奪官。

translations.literal: At the capital evaluation he recommended his brother Guodong and, for favoritism, was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital evaluation he recommended his brother Guodong and, convicted of favoritism, lost his post.

sentences.zh: 尋授編修，直上書房。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed compiler and served in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made a compiler in the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，复授內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was again appointed grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 28 he was again made grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 是歲，上以諸回部悉定，復遣尚書明安圖等往測天度繪圖，是為乾隆內府皇輿圖。

translations.literal: That year, because all the Muslim regions had been settled, the emperor again sent Minister Ming'antu and others to measure celestial degrees and survey maps; this was the Qianlong inner-court imperial atlas.
translations.idiomatic: That year, with the Muslim regions pacified, the emperor again sent Minister Ming'antu and others to measure and survey—the Qianlong inner-court atlas.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，遷禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was transferred to vice minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 26 he became vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，以老休致。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, on account of age, he retired.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 he retired on grounds of age.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Qianlong 31.

sentences.zh: 論曰：國家撫有疆宇，謂之版圖，版言乎其有民，圖言乎其有地。

translations.literal: The commentator says: When the state pacifies its territory it is called ban tu—ban meaning that it has people, tu that it has land.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator writes: When the state holds its realm it speaks of ban tu—ban of its people, tu of its territory.

sentences.zh: 聖祖東訪長白山，西探河源，北撫土爾扈特，武默訥、舒蘭、圖理琛奉使稱職。

translations.literal: The Sagely Ancestor visited Mount Changbai in the east and traced the river source in the west, and received the Torghut in the north; Wu Mo'ne, Shulan, and Tulichen discharged their missions with credit.
translations.idiomatic: The Sagely Ancestor worshipped at Mount Changbai, traced the Yellow River westward, and received the Torghut in the north; Wu Mo'ne, Shulan, and Tulichen all served with distinction.

sentences.zh: 觀所還奏，曲折詳盡，歷歷如繪。

translations.literal: Judging from their returned memorials, the accounts are winding and thorough, vivid as paintings.
translations.idiomatic: Their memorials are winding yet thorough, vivid as painted scrolls.

sentences.zh: 國宗以明算事聖祖，又幸老壽，迨高宗朝，詣新疆測繪。

translations.literal: Guozong, skilled in calculation, served the Sagely Ancestor; fortunate in long life, he reached the Gaozong court and went to Xinjiang to survey.
translations.idiomatic: Guozong served the Sagely Ancestor with mathematics, lived to great age, and under Gaozong surveyed Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 康熙、乾隆兩內府圖皆躬與編摹。

translations.literal: He took part in compiling both the Kangxi and Qianlong inner-court atlases.
translations.idiomatic: He helped compile both the Kangxi and Qianlong inner-court atlases.

sentences.zh: 揆之於古，其裴秀、賈耽之倫歟？

translations.literal: Measured against antiquity, is he not of the company of Pei Xiu and Jia Dan?
translations.idiomatic: By the standard of antiquity, is he not Pei Xiu and Jia Dan reborn?
